metadata.policy: Static official species with three known catalog components and an existing official special sprite. Bosses and cardboard excluded. Compound types expanded to ordinary catalog types; database stats preserved.

triples.name: Zapmolcuno
triples.description: Zapmolcuno is a three-way fusion between Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres that was created using Team Rocket's fusion machine. Further improvements by Colress has made the fusion stable enough to be used in battles.
